title: Insignia Brings Back Online Multiplayer For Lots More Xbox Games, Including Burnout 3
summary:
The replacement service for Xbox Live 1.0.

It's been around six months since we last talked about Insignia — the unofficial replacement service for Xbox Live on the original Xbox — and that's mainly because it stopped growing its list of supported games for quite a while.

In recent days though, the team have suddenly become very active in adding lots of new games to the list, including Burnout 3: Takedown, Delta Force Black Hawk Down, MTX Motorax, NFL Blitz: The League, Monster Garage, NASCAR 2005: Chase for the Cup, NCAA Football 2005, Bicycle Casino, Robotech: Invasion, Madden NFL 2005, Gotcha! and NHL 2005. There's likely a lot more to come in the days and weeks ahead as well.

title: Forgotten Monkey Survival Sim Getting Free Xbox Series X|S Upgrade This December
summary:
Time to grow up.

As far as my current-gen upgrade wishlist goes, the Xbox One animal evolution sim Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey certainly was not in my top three. But hey ho let's go, because the game is set to evolve December 8th on Xbox Series X|S.

Panache Digital Games has entirely rebuilt the game in Unreal Engine 5, and whilst this is essentially a new version, owners of the Xbox One release can upgrade for free. This remaster will also feature a proper photo mode and new "documentary-style narration", and spruce things up with a little bit of polish beyond the expected quality-of-life enhancements.
